Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 1,000 — the cycle total including this filer's earlier 6-15-2010 report — and is NOT summed as an increment; the 500 difference between the two columns is exactly what the per-period regime exists to keep separate, and NOTHING was differenced across the two filings to derive anything here. The p2 balance ladder closes on its own terms: line 3 -2,049.71 (a NEGATIVE carried balance, printed with a leading minus) + line 4 500 = line 5 -1,549.71; less line 6 (a slashed zero = 0) = line 7 -1,549.71.
